tagline: Know the job is real. Walk in prepared.
brief: A job-intelligence app for students and early-career engineers in India: it finds roles worth applying to, tells you whether a posting is still live, and gets you ready for the interview. The mark has to feel sharp, honest and calm, work at 16 px in a browser tab, and sit in a true-black, Apple-style interface.
criteria: Success: reads as a radar without the clichés (concentric rings, crosshairs, RSS-like arcs), survives 16 px, works in one colour, and sits naturally on black.

concepts.name: Sweep
concepts.idea: A radar quadrant mid-sweep: the beam cut in as one line, and a blip it has found.
rationale: One solid shape, so it holds up as a favicon and app icon
The beam and blip are negative space: the signal found in the noise
System blue #0A84FF, the app's own accent, on true black or white
A dedicated small cut keeps beam and blip apart at 16 px

recommendation: Sweep: final artwork. Symbol, small cut, horizontal and stacked lockups, wordmark, one-colour versions and the web icon set are in brand/logo.
next_steps: Run a trademark search before public use
Swap the app's 'R' brand mark and favicon for the new files
